body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review, main report §4 Disputed findings (scratchpad review/out/panel-report.md). Both verifiers confirmed the code facts; they split on whether the behaviour is a defect or an accepted documented choice. Owner instruction 2026-09-25: known issues are addressed before the next release. Settle the split (spec amendment or fix) as the finding's own 'Settles it' text says, then fix or record the accepted choice. Finding text: Use-case ledger promotes all three Core jobs to VERIFIED on self-attested PASS tokens whose bound subjects show the defects in V1-0263 and V1-0260 (admission high; 1/2). Agreed: `conformance/use-cases-v0/main.go:233-296` checks outcome and repository only; the UC-CHANGE-CONSEQUENCE receipt omits the cross-package caller; the completion receipt has linked 0 of 4; evidence spans four different builds; `ledger.json` has no revision scope. Split: UCV0-006/009 say the runner proves envelope integrity, not subject truth, so the defect is in admission, not code. Settles it: both verifiers agree the VERIFIED rows should be bound to a candidate revision and digest with a staleness rule and re-derived on rc.1 bytes before V1-0021 closes. That is a process requirement, not a code change, and the chair treats it as a condition of rc.1.
